label: Finite recombination and prefix closure separate full-law arbitrariness
summary:
Issue #1867 upstream test: proposed RecombinationFork derives finite-pattern richness from a nonempty admitted class with same-selector one-step extension, and whole-suffix richness from finite richness plus independent prefix closure. The nonempty eventually-constant histories satisfy one-step/finite richness yet exclude a specifically alternating infinite history; the stable class is closed but not rich, the unrestricted class supplies the positive control, and the empty class isolates nonemptiness. Mathematically the finite-richness-plus-closure step is the standard Cantor-space fact (a closed set dense in a cylinder contains the cylinder); the progress is the application, not new mathematics. Reuses existing Profile/Cell, splice and the stable-groundless control instead of claiming that U entails S. The hand-off from the selector-relative WholeSuffixRich to the downstream #1809 certificate (SuffixComplete/UniversalProjection over a Profile cell) and #1808 internalDiscipline (BothSuccessors over Stance.admits) is supplied by Lean-only, unregistered adapter lemmas in TruthCore/Results/Explanation/NoFoundationLawChaos/Adapters.lean, which also prove that the satisfiers of one fixed Profile form a prefix-closed selector. Note docs/notes/no-foundation-law-chaos.md contains the actual law versus state, Humean best-system, primitive/dispositional law, necessary impersonal/theistic source, and epistemic norm interpretations. Whether naturalism or U undermines epistemic entitlement (the ultimate-ground epistemic-necessity bridge e519065f) was not assessed. An independent semantic challenge on PR #1874 (repair pass 1) found the downstream connection drawn as existing before any adapter existed and an unsupported universal non-entailment claim about naturalism; both were repaired. Successful mathematical construction is not itself philosophical verification.

Retrospective proof-coverage audit, issue #2103 slice 1. Analyst formulations with attribution deferred. (a) Nonempty one-step continuation freedom implies finite richness and, with independent prefix closure, whole-suffix richness (c3d1c793, argument 7154e234, result 765d8679, NoFoundationLawChaos.recombinationFork; definitions 1e04df16 and 10d0fb41). (c) NoFoundationLawChaos.Adapters.wholeSuffix_profile, wholeSuffix_no_forecast, wholeSuffix_future_total, wholeSuffix_no_deterministic and selector_internalDiscipline compile without separate result IDs. They consume the selector membership hypothesis, the explicit Profile conformity or record-only hypothesis where needed, and the registered downstream results NoFoundationLawChaos.certificate (6e3bad3f, argument 50ff5c59) and NoFoundationPractice.internalDiscipline (01188cb4, argument 394faa75). (a) The weaker exact output tests in AdjacentPairContainment.exposureCertificate (33c7a1c3) already handle one-time forecasting and pair-excluding profiles without infinite closure. (e) No registered or compiled declaration was found that derives the recombination or closure inputs from a failure of existential explanation. NoFoundationLawChaos.omissions (9d9c1993, argument 6d80fd9f) and UltimateExplanation.certificate (3d8486c8) permit a stable populated profile with no GroundedTotality in the supplied product interpretation. This is a formal scope-ground control, not a demonstrated metaphysical possibility or an objection to B2. The intended root contact is through 608a262d. The missing link from the #312 reason of a contingent bearer (e7302a28) to scope-ground absence (DEF-REGULARITY-GROUND) precedes any bridge to alternative histories.
blocker:
The substantive U→N/R/C metaphysical applicability, preservation of governing law/bearer identity, ontic-to-epistemic entitlement, and a sense-checked bridge from the denial of the root-route local existence PSR for contingents (608a262d) to U here all remain OPEN; the adapters connect only the formal hand-off.

Ask whether one specific opposite next-bit outcome is admissible under those restrictions. Only pursue finite richness and prefix closure for the stronger whole-suffix claim.
